focus_areas: Fur texture transition from forequarters to hindquarters
Structural plausibility of the shoulder hump and spine
Edge definition against the background vegetation
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the dark shaggy fur and the brown smooth fur. AI models often create a 'muddy' or blended texture here rather than a distinct anatomical change. Also, scrutinize the white debris in the foreground; if it lacks coherent structure or shadows, it may indicate generative noise. Ensure the topology auditor uses the bounding boxes from the detector to avoid segmenting background grass as part of the bison.
image_description: A side-profile view of a large American Bison standing in a grassy field. The animal features a massive, dark-furred forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to lighter brown, less dense fur on the hindquarters. A single curved horn is clearly visible on the left side of its broad head, which also displays a shaggy beard. The legs are sturdy and dark, partially obscured by tall grass and white foreground debris.
